name: Campus Cards
tagline: Place cards for the ten University of California campuses, one set at a time.
notice: Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
creator: tz2FjJhB1gb9Xc2qNB7QgFkdBZkGCCRMxdFw

sets.title: Set 01 · Santa Barbara
sets.subtitle: Goleta & Isla Vista, where the campus runs out of land

cards.title: Storke Tower
cards.flavor: The carillon tower at the middle of campus. You can find your way home by it.

cards.title: Campus Point
cards.flavor: The bluff tip where the campus meets the channel. Surf check, then class.

cards.title: Coal Oil Point
cards.flavor: Dunes and a slough at the west end of Isla Vista. Small shorebirds nest here; walk around them.

cards.title: The Lagoon
cards.flavor: A tidal lagoon the campus wraps around. Herons stand very still in it.

cards.title: Del Playa Sunset
cards.flavor: Every backyard on the ocean side ends at a cliff. Everyone faces west at the same time.

cards.title: The Islands
cards.flavor: On a clear day the Channel Islands sit on the horizon like they were painted there.

cards.title: Pardall Tunnel
cards.flavor: The bike tunnel between Isla Vista and campus. Ring your bell on the way in.

cards.title: The Roundabout
cards.flavor: Bike traffic circles. Counterclockwise, no stopping, trust the flow.

cards.title: Ten Thousand Bikes
cards.flavor: Racks outside every lecture hall at ten to the hour. Remember where you locked it.

cards.title: Goleta Pier
cards.flavor: A long wooden pier past the slough. Fishing lines, pelicans, a slow walk back.

cards.title: The Santa Ynez
cards.flavor: The mountains behind everything. They turn pink for about four minutes at dusk.

cards.title: Marine Layer
cards.flavor: Mornings start grey. By noon it burns off and the whole coast shows up.

sets.title: Set 02 · Berkeley
sets.subtitle: The East Bay, where the hills look straight out through the Golden Gate

cards.title: Sather Tower
cards.flavor: The campanile. The bells play at noon and you can hear them from half of town.

cards.title: Sather Gate
cards.flavor: The bronze gate on the old south edge of campus. Everyone walks through it eventually.

cards.title: The Bay from Above
cards.flavor: Climb the fire trails at sunset and the whole bay lines up, bridge and all.

cards.title: Sproul Steps
cards.flavor: The steps where people have been standing up to speak since 1964. Bring something to say.

cards.title: The Greek Theatre
cards.flavor: An open-air amphitheater in the eucalyptus. The stone seats stay warm after dark.

cards.title: Memorial Glade
cards.flavor: The big lawn in front of the library. Blankets, frisbees, one person actually studying.

cards.title: Strawberry Creek
cards.flavor: A creek runs right through campus under little footbridges. Stop and listen for it.

cards.title: Eucalyptus Grove
cards.flavor: Very tall trees on the west side of campus. The air smells like cough drops.

cards.title: Telegraph Avenue
cards.flavor: Records, tie-dye, vendor tables, a slice of pizza. Four blocks that never quite close.

cards.title: Downtown BART
cards.flavor: The train under Shattuck. Twenty-some minutes to the city, less if you run the stairs.

cards.title: Tilden Carousel
cards.flavor: Up in the park above the hills, an old carousel keeps going around.

cards.title: Fog at the Gate
cards.flavor: Late afternoon the fog pours in through the Golden Gate like it has somewhere to be.
